title: Tennessee Code Title 50, Chapter 2 - Wage Regulations
verified_how: expanded the register's own table of contents at https://www.lexisnexis.com/hottopics/tncode/ (Tennessee Code Unannotated - Free Public Access): 'Title 50 Employer And Employee' expands to eleven chapters, of which 'Chapter 2 Wage Regulations' is one, carrying no [Reserved] or [Repealed] marker (the TOC does print such markers elsewhere, e.g. 'Title 51 [Reserved]' and 'Chapters 38-39 [Reserved]' under Title 56, so their absence is informative). No section text was opened and the platform publishes no currency date on the table of contents.
notes: in_force is 'unclear' rather than 'yes' for a purely evidential reason: the chapter is present and unmarked in the current table of contents of the state-sponsored edition, which is good evidence it is live, but the register publishes no as-at date and the state's own host is unreachable, so in-force status has not been verified to the standard the other jurisdictions in this file meet. The same caveat applies to every Act listed for Tennessee. Substantively this is Tennessee's wage payment and regulation chapter (pay frequency, wage statements, deductions, final wages); Tennessee sets no state minimum wage, so the federal FLSA rate applies.
